title: Champagne Before Confirmation
logline: Bull celebrates a rumored inflow record before anyone has actually confirmed it.

source.headline: Fictional Exchange Reports Record Inflows Into Animal Token Fund
source.summary: A made-up trading desk claims an unusually strong day of inflows into a fictional fund. Nothing is confirmed and no real market data is referenced.
source.factual_notes: Entirely fictional scenario for demonstration. Not investment advice; no price prediction; no reliance on live facts.

creative_direction.continuity_notes: Keep Walter dry and sparse. The champagne is a running visual gag across the episode.

characters.description: Relentlessly optimistic trader who celebrates first and checks later.
Skeptical and tired; expects the worst on principle.
characters.continuity_notes: Rarely makes eye contact with the celebration.

characters.description: Quiet, dry closer who delivers the final understated line.
characters.continuity_notes: Speaks at most once; the punchline lands on his silence.

scenes.description: Open office with monitors, a doom board, and a snack table.

props.description: Oversized celebratory bottle that keeps reappearing.

costumes.description: Bright vest with too many pockets.

shots.title: The premature toast
shots.script_excerpt: Bull bursts in with the champagne before anyone can react.
shots.action: Bull kicks the door open, champagne raised over his head.

dialogue.text: Record day! We are so back!

shots.image_prompt: trading floor, bull raising a champagne bottle, bear slouched in background, anime, cel-shaded
shots.video_prompt: bull kicks door open and raises champagne, bear does not look up, 8 seconds
shots.negative_prompt: no real logos, no real ticker symbols, no text overlays

shots.title: The unread notification
shots.script_excerpt: Bear points at the phone; the number is unconfirmed.
shots.action: Bear slides the phone across the desk; the screen says 'PENDING'.
shots.image_prompt: close up of a phone reading PENDING, bull leaning in confidently, anime
shots.video_prompt: bear slides phone forward, bull waves it off, 10 seconds
shots.negative_prompt: no real app UI, no real brand names

shots.title: The escalation
shots.script_excerpt: Bull pours anyway; Bear braces for the correction.
shots.action: Bull pops the champagne; foam goes everywhere; Bear covers his monitor.

dialogue.text: To confirmation that definitely will happen!

shots.image_prompt: champagne foam exploding across a trading desk, bear shielding a monitor, anime, dynamic
shots.video_prompt: champagne pops, foam sprays, bear ducks, 12 seconds
shots.negative_prompt: no real market charts, no numbers on screens
shots.continuity_notes: Payoff of the champagne gag from SC01.

shots.title: The quiet correction
shots.script_excerpt: Walter reads the phone and says one thing.
shots.action: Walter picks up the phone, glances at it, sets it face down. Beat. He walks off.
shots.image_prompt: walter setting a phone face down on a foam-covered desk, deadpan, anime
shots.video_prompt: walter reads phone, sets it down, walks off, freeze on bull's face, 9 seconds
shots.negative_prompt: no explanatory text, no captions after the line
shots.continuity_notes: Punchline lands on Walter's exit; do not add an explaining beat after this.
